name: EDM GP: Melodic House & Techno
_source: Checked 2026-10-30 against edm-ghost-production.com/for-sellers/package. Platform rules change: check them before each submission and edit this file.

null_test._note: Starting thresholds. Tune on the first real exports.

master._peak_note: The seller page (checked 2026-10-30) says peak 0 dB to -0.3 dB on every mastered mix. The CRYX MASTER rack limits at -1.0 dB true peak, which misses that. Still only a WARN until Carlos decides: raise the limiter ceiling to about -0.2 dB, then set peak_confirmed to true.

mixes._radio_stems_note: OPEN QUESTION (BRIEF.md section 8.3): are radio stems delivered?

checklist: Every melodic part (bass, lead, pad, arp, synth) has its own MIDI file, named like the stem (Bass.mid, Lead.mid).
Vocals in the track (even chops, adlibs or one-shots)? Add an Instrumental Mix (mastered WAV + MP3) and its unmastered WAV.
Unmastered WAVs for every version (extended, radio, instrumental), no plugins on the master, all at the same peak between -3 and -6 dB.
Used groups for mixing? Put the ungrouped stems in a folder called 'Ungrouped' inside 'Stems'.
Radio mix only if the extended mix has an 8 to 32 bar intro and outro; about 2 to 3 minutes.
No contact details or personal info anywhere: file names, ID3 tags, project files, metadata.
